A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HEIE research work. All 11 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables, and references, support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains appendix sections.

before.justification: V1 reports original HEIE evaluations, cross-dataset generalization experiments, ablations, and qualitative outputs in Tables 1–7 and Figures 4–6.

after.justification: V2 retains the original HEIE experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, explanation evaluations, cross-dataset generalization, and ablations.

M1.justification: The hierarchical mapper, uncertainty-based fusion, verisimilitude scorer, and five-step CoT procedure are retained. V2 newly specifies the layer supplying [MAP] features, without establishing a change to the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain RichHF-18K and AbHuman coverage and their explanation-enriched Expl-AIGI-Eval annotations. Heatmap prediction, score prediction, explanation evaluation, and cross-dataset transfer scenarios remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–4 retain identical comparator membership, including both RAHF variants in Table 1 and GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet in Table 2. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Both retain the original train-validation splits, InternVL-8B backbone, learning rate of 0.0003, warmup ratio of 0.03, batch size of 16, and evaluation metrics. Removing dataset-description details does not establish a changed experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The mapper, scorer, and CoT ablations in Tables 5–7 are unchanged, as are the cross-domain analysis and qualitative cases in Figures 4–6. No additional robustness or sensitivity analysis appears.

E5.justification: Neither version reports evaluation seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The retained Laplace uncertainty concerns the model's heatmap fusion rather than statistical uncertainty in experimental results.

E6.justification: All reported entries in Tables 1–7 match after citation renumbering, and Figures 4–6 retain the same qualitative outputs. For example, HEIE's RichHF-18K MSE remains 0.00825 and PLCC remains 0.697.

T1.justification: Equation (1) substitutes T and F for the equivalent E_text and E_img notation defined in v1. The computations, heatmap concatenation, Laplace objective, and distribution definition remain unchanged; no proofs or formal assumptions are added.

C1.justification: The novelty, methodological contributions, and state-of-the-art claims remain intact. Introduction contribution 4 changes the dataset claim from future public availability to 'construct and publish,' a limited update to the claimed delivered contribution.

C2.justification: V2 removes the explicit qualification that RAHF's performance on AbHuman remains uncertain in Section 4.2. The general disclosure that RAHF is not open source and its scores come from its paper remains, so the narrowing of comparison caveats is limited.

D1.justification: V2 specifies the final-layer [MAP] features and mask-derived red contours used for visual prompting, and adds a project link and dataset-release claim. However, Section 3.4 removes the 42,760-image count, 20 query expressions per image, and 20% manual-review disclosure. These are documentation changes without established procedural changes.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations including Claude 3.5 Sonnet, TempME, FastVID, LLaVA-MLB, ACNet, and YOLOv10, while removing One-dimensional Adapter, Temporal Scaling Law, and TAD. These update supporting references without substantially changing the positioning against RichHF and HumanRefiner.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized explanatory revisions in Sections 3.2.1 and 3.4, edits author affiliations and contribution markers, and reformats numbered passages. The section hierarchy and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: V2 repositions Tables 6–7 within page 8 and reflows the title, surrounding text, and references. All six figures and seven tables retain their display structures and visual examples.

improvement.justification: V2 clarifies feature extraction and visual prompting and adds a project link with a dataset-release claim. However, it removes dataset size, instruction-generation counts, and manual-review coverage from Section 3.4, weakening reproducibility and quality-assurance documentation. The experimental evidence is unchanged. These concrete gains and losses leave the net effect on overall paper quality uncertain.
